gaps: Every input is already used by the test suite; no held-out quality set is present.
Original-document XLSM, XLSB and ODS coverage is absent; these variants use upstream parser fixtures.
No wholly unruled standalone PDF table, mixed PDF with an entirely textless page, nonzero page-box origin, encrypted PDF or malformed PDF is confirmed.
No workbook establishes leading empty columns, ragged Python rows, error cells, missing or stale formula caches, or XLSX/XLSM formula cells.
No workbook establishes 1904 dates, old BIFF generations, strict OOXML, password handling, malformed archives or large sparse-sheet scaling.
No corpus DOCX establishes Strict WordprocessingML, vertical table merges, tracked-change reconstruction or embedded image handling.
No corpus PPTX establishes external pictures, grouped shapes, merged table cells, animations or transitions.
Features describe inputs, not correct extraction. OCR, formula calculation, VBA execution and chart extraction are outside brewdoc acceptance.

All 105 PDF pages, 54 workbook sheets, 6 DOCX main stories and 15 PPTX slides have complete annotations within their declared inspection scope. XLSB formula expressions are not decompiled; token record types, locations and cached results are inventoried. Visual rendering, formula recalculation and full binary-format conformance audits were not performed.
